notes.title: Final Beta
notes.notes:
[u][b]The final Beta is here![/b][/u]

This is it -- the home stretch. After about a year and a half, we are finally coming to the end of this game development journey. 

After typing thousands of lines of code, crafting dozens of animations, making music, sound effects, and everything else involved in making a game now [b]I need your help![/b]

Follow the link below (password: nunwithgun):
[url=https://super8bitrafa.itch.io/in-the-dead-of-night]BETA DOWNLOAD[/url]

Remember to leave feedback to help with the development of the game. If you can record your gameplay please do so.

[u][b]Lexington Comic Con[/b][/u]

Thanks to all those at Lexington Comic and Toy Con that played the game and gave valuable feedback. The beta link above is essentially the same build shown there with a few minor updates. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014216/d07ad2525c01e279a51695c9a2203116aca60f3e.jpg[/img]

It was great to see people having fun with the game and listening to the great feedback.

Thanks to everyone who has supported the game. The next update will include a name change (those who have played the beta will know what I'm talking about) and a release date announcement (finally!!!).

notes.title: Improved lighting, new locations, and customizable controls
notes.notes:
Greetings Dead of Night fans!

I'm very excited to announce some major updates to the game. I have been working tirelessly to improve the game and enhance the overall player experience. Here are some of the improvements I’ve made:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014216/123463f60ba5666586551439eff2d9671f55ee2a.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Better Lighting: [/b]I’ve added more realistic lighting to enhance the creepy and eerie atmosphere of the game. You’ll feel like you’re really in the middle of the apocalypse.

[*] [b]Toggle Momentum: [/b]I heard your feedback and have added an option to toggle momentum when running. You can now customize your gameplay experience to your liking.

[*] [b]New Locations:[/b] I’ve added more locations to explore and discover, including sewers, towns, and more.

[*] [b]Procedurally Generated Dialogue: [/b]I’ve added a new system for generating dialogue, so each playthrough will be unique and different.
[/list]

I'm not ready to announce a release date just yet but stay tuned for more information. I'm confident that these updates will make In the Dead of Night an even more immersive and terrifying experience. Expect these updates to come to the demo in the next day or so.

Thank you for your continued support, and we can’t wait to share more with you soon.

notes.title: Demo Update + New Logo
notes.notes:
[b]Small Update[/b]

I've changed a few things to improve the overall experience of playing the demo. This is actually the second update since Next Fest started so I'll include the previous changes here as well. I'm listening to player feedback as well so expect another update before Next Fest is over and make sure you leave your thoughts and first impressions (but please be kind I'm a one-man team). Here's a list of some of the things that were changed in the last two updates:

[list]
[*] New graphics for powerups
[*] New HUD displays powerups collected
[*] HUD also displays how many powerups you've stacked (x2, x3, etc)
[*] Menu now includes an option to leave feedback on Reddit (should I link to the steam page as well?)
[*] Exiting the pause menu is less jarring now. The red flash has been removed.
[*] Pausing the game no longer causes glitches
[*] Boss battles no longer cause minor glitches
[*] Better FX overall
[/list]

[b]Shiny new logo![/b]

I've updated the in-game look of the logo and menus a bit and I've changed all the graphics on the steam page to match, Let me know what you think.

Well, that's all for today. Thanks so much for playing!

notes.title: Free Demo
notes.notes:
Hi all! My first SHMUP game has an early demo available on steam and I’d love to get feedback ahead of Steam Next Fest. 

In the Dead of Night is a grindhouse, anime, horror-inspired story with a hand-drawn, cartoony aesthetic about a monster-hunting nun but it’s really just a classic-style arcade shmup at heart. The game is still very much in development so its identity is evolving every day. So far, though, it’s a little bit bullet hell, a little bit b-movie, some survivor-like gameplay has crept in lately and there are a lot of comic book influences.

The demo includes two sections from the story mode and an arcade mode with co-op.

Feel free to leave any and all feedback here:

[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/shmups/comments/10mc551/demo_sexy_demonslaying_nun_with_a_gun_in_the_dead/]HERE[/url]
